dedupe_keys.name: geoikp geospatial information knowledge platform of the operandum project nature based solutions catalogue hazard and risk data gis tools and case studies for hydro meteorological risk reduction

description: GeoIKP is the web knowledge platform of OPERANDUM, an EU Horizon 2020 project on nature-based solutions against hydro-meteorological hazards. The platform read on 2026-09-28 opens on six user profiles, each with its own tools: scientists get hazard and risk data, advanced GIS tools and case studies; businesses and investors find partners, technical data and legislation; policy makers get a catalogue of nature-based solutions, multi-level policies and best practices; associations and citizens explore local risk and the effect of the solutions; and media get risk maps and examples. A 2022 EGU abstract by Leo and colleagues describes it as an open platform integrating science, policy and practice modules. Coverage is mainly Europe; the geographic extent of the data was not read. Access is free on the web and no licence is stated on the landing page. Caveats: the data layers, their sources and downloads were not opened, and as a project platform its upkeep after the project ended is uncertain. It supports adaptation planning, such as choosing nature-based flood or slope protection for a river valley and comparing it with grey infrastructure. Related records: OPERANDUM coastal modelling data from Emilia-Romagna and the Oppla repository.
